text:
rachel: Heads-up: after yesterday's kernel-selector tweak we see a latency tail on dedicated pool. Traces point to phase conflation — prefill+decode interleaving forming giant batches that hit slow kernel path and thrash KV.

kevin: saw it. perf dashboard spike ~30% p95 for short chats. suspect batcher forms batches with mixed phase reqs; kernel chooses decode-optimized kernels w/ long seq paths.

thomas: profiling snapshot from a canary node:
```
prefill_time_ms: 12
decode_time_ms: 28
kernel_switches: 3
kv_miss_rate: 47%
avg_batch_size: 14
mixed_phase_batches: 38%
```

maria: deploy-bot shows canary yanked at 09:12 — rollback reason: latency_regression :grimacing:

kevin: quick experiment: enable phase_separation=true and set token_budget_target=24 on canary. command:
```
redwoodctl deploy --pool canary --set batcher.phase_separation=true --set batcher.token_budget_target=24
```

thomas: ran it on canary for 20m: p95 down ~18%, kv_miss_rate -> 12%, throughput steady. logs:
```
[canary] p50=10ms p95=42ms p99=90ms
[canary] kv_hits=88% kv_misses=12%
[canary] mixed_phase_batches=6%
```

rachel: nice. two follow-ups: 1) add phase-aware batcher heuristic: prefer homogeneous-phase batches when seq_len <= 64; 2) kernel selector: add small fallback cost penalty to prefer prefill-optimized kernel when batches are mixed.

maria: question: will this increase small-request latency? need perf map by route before wide rollout.

kevin: agree. plan: A/B traffic 5% for 6h -> perf-bot will collect token-level histograms + kv-hit matrix. also add metric infra.phase_conflation_rate.

perf-bot: metric infra.phase_conflation_rate created. alert: >0.05 for 5m

rachel: I'll draft rollback-safe rollout: canary -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% with automated revert on phase_conflation_rate or p95 increase >10%. tagging eng-sre.

maria: @eng-sre please watch canary tonight. I'll push canary in 10.

kevin: pushed. cc perf-bot: collect KV heatmap every 2m.

deploy-bot: deploy: phase-split-batcher v2 -> canary (id: d-8971) started

thomas: one tiny note: batching timer bump from 2ms -> 1ms avoids prefill starving decode; otherwise separation hurts throughput.

rachel: good catch. will include that in canary config and add it to rollout notes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
